artworks.title: Le Vice suprème: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image shows two skeletal figures in a macabre setting. One figure is stepping out of a coffin, while the other is holding its detached head. Both figures are standing on a platform with animal and human forms underneath. Birds fly above them in a dark atmosphere. The drawing features dark, intricate line work.

artworks.title: La Ronde
artworks.description: The image shows six figures in a circle, holding hands. They are standing in a static, upright position with their hands linked together. The figures have indistinct facial features with soft shading and their hair is undefined, some tied back and others down. They are wearing long dresses with puffed sleeves. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a dark textured pattern that contrasts with the lightness of the figures.

artworks.title: Sketch Plate
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring multiple human figures and heads in various positions and orientations. In the upper section of the image, there is a head tilted downwards with long flowing hair. Below this figure, slightly to the left, there is the profile of another head with defined facial features and a head covering. Near the center of the drawing, a pair of figures is depicted standing with their upper bodies visible, both facing each other. One has voluminous hair and is turned slightly to the side, while the other is depicted from behind, draped in a dark garment. To the right, multiple profiles of heads with varying facial features are illustrated, overlapping and intertwining. The background is textured with crosshatching, shading the upper left corner of the image, providing contrast to the more delicate line work of the figures. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: A Edgar Poe
artworks.description: The image shows a man's face and upper torso. He is facing forward with a direct gaze. The man has deep-set eyes, a defined nose, and a distinctive mustache. His hair is dark, wavy, and extends outward on both sides. He is wearing a dark garment with a light-colored cravat around his neck. The background has a textured effect with horizontal lines, and the name "A EDGAR POE" is inscribed at the bottom. In the bottom right corner, there are initials "FV."

artworks.title: Brother Martin with Goetz
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. The person on the left is sitting on a bench, while the person on the right is standing. The person sitting wears a long robe with a cape and has short, dark hair. The standing person has a beard, mustache, and medium-length dark hair covered by a pointed hat. They wear a suit of armor with a fur-lined cloak. The room has medieval decorations like a flag, a spear, and a sack on the floor. The background has a rough wall and a partially visible curtain.

artworks.title: Mephisto Appears to Faust
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction between two individuals in a richly decorated interior. The scene takes place in a study or library filled with books and various objects. One individual sits at a desk or table with an open book, engaged in conversation with the second individual standing nearby. The seated figure is dressed in a robe, while the standing figure wears an elaborate costume with a feathered cap and holds a staff. The room has various items like a curtain with intricate designs, a shelf with skulls and other curios, and a sculpture or statuette on the lower right. The artwork features detailed cross-hatching and dramatic contrasts in lighting, creating depth and texture. The overall ambiance suggests a scene based on a literary or historical theme.

artworks.title: Jeanne de Bourgogne
artworks.description: The image contains two full-length figures. On the right, a seated woman is being touched on the arm by a standing man. The woman has long hair and a headdress, wearing a flowing gown with a belt. The man is reaching out towards her, with a decorated horse tied beside him. In the background, a castle wall and a distant figure on a gallows can be seen. Textures in the stone and clothing create a dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Faust and Wagner
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting on a bench. They are seated closely together, with one man crossing his legs and resting his hands on a walking stick while the other man leans forward with his elbow on his knee and chin in his hand. The man on the left has a long, pointed beard and wears a flat, dark hat. The man on the right wears a dark hat and a short beard. Both men wear long cloaks with patterned sleeves visible under their cloaks. The man on the left has a robe covering his legs, and both wear light-colored shoes. The background includes bare trees and detailed, multi-story buildings with varied roof lines, cobbled walls, and windows. Faint outlines of other figures and activity are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view, focusing on his upper body. He appears to be standing or possibly leaning slightly, with his arms supporting his stance. The man has strong facial features, including prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and a receding hairline. He is wearing a textured jacket over a white shirt. In his left hand, he holds a scroll with the word "DON QUIJOTE" on it, and his right hand is near a sword hilt. In the background, there is an ethereal figure reaching towards the sky, surrounded by celestial motifs.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of GTE and the New Century Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure on horseback holding a lance against an abstract background. The composition features a dark figure on horseback in the upper left, casting a shadow behind them. The horse and rider appear sculpted from darkness with highlights and textures suggesting form. The right side of the painting has swirling strokes implying motion or energy. Chiaroscuro creates a dramatic and mysterious atmosphere. This is in the style of Odilon Redon.

artworks.title: Hunchback Playing a Lute
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking to the right, holding a guitar-like instrument. The person is in profile, with a focused expression, medium-length hair under a wide-brimmed hat. They wear loose-fitting clothing and the background includes a house with bushes and a windy sky.

artworks.title: A Book Peddler
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a field. The person is in a slight lean forward, holding a tray with their right hand that contains brushes and a long stick with their left hand. They have facial hair and an open mouth. The person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long, tattered coat with a cross patch on the left arm. The coat and sleeves have tears, and the lower part of the coat is frayed. The person's legs are covered with ragged material, and they are wearing pointed shoes. In the background, there is a house and a cluster of bushes or trees.

artworks.title: Satyr Carrying a Nymph on His Back
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a forest setting. The central figure carries another figure on its back, while a third figure holds a musical instrument. The scene is amidst water and lush foliage, with detailed shading and patterns on the leaves. The use of line work and stippling creates texture, giving depth to the scene.

artworks.title: L'Ile Séguin in Flood
artworks.medium: etching in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a dense forest scene. The artwork features intricate patterns of trees with a monochromatic color palette of black and grey. The etched trees have detailed bark and foliage, creating a sense of depth. There is a hint of sunlight filtering through the canopy and reflecting off a small body of water in the foreground.

artworks.title: Arnautes, Égypte (Albanians, Egypt)
artworks.description: The image features two men. The man on the left is facing forward, holding a long staff or rifle with one hand, while the other hand rests on a sword at his waist. He has a mustache and is wearing a wrap around his head. The man on the right is in profile, facing towards the back, and has long hair cascading from under a fez-like cap. Both men wear traditional clothing with knee-high boots. The man on the left has a pouch attached to his belt. The one on the right is holding the stock of a rifle. In the background, there is a large tent, surrounded by sandy terrain.

artworks.title: A Turk
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person standing in a relaxed yet poised position, with one arm partially raised. The individual has a pronounced mustache, long hair flowing past the shoulders, and defined facial features. They are dressed in a flowing robe or cloak, layered loose-fitting garment, and a necklace made of circular beads. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the person's figure and attire.

artworks.title: Attaque du tigre
artworks.description: In the image, a horseman is in conflict with a tiger. The tiger is attacking the horse and rider, with the horse appearing startled and the rider wielding a spear. The scene is depicted in black and white with dynamic lines and shading, emphasizing the intense and dramatic nature of the encounter.

artworks.title: Le Lion et le tigre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tiger and a lion. The tiger is lying on a rock surface, while the lion is below with an alert expression. The background is dark, emphasizing the animals' features. The fur and musculature details are realistically depicted.

artworks.title: Le Sommeil du lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion lying asleep in a dark cave. There is a figure in the background holding a rifle. The lion is peacefully sleeping with its head resting on its forepaw and its body curled. The cave is dark, but a portion is illuminated. In the background, a figure is partly concealed in the shadows, observing the lion. The drawing uses light and shadow to create a suspenseful mood.

artworks.title: Attaque du lion
artworks.description: This is an image showing two horses confronting a lion. One horse shows alarm and movement, while the other horse is in a tense stance. A person is depicted holding a spear and defending against the lion. The horses have dynamic poses with flowing manes, conveying a sense of action. The scene has high contrast and detailed textures, creating a vibrant atmosphere. The artist has depicted the encounter with careful shading and line work, capturing the dramatic moment.

artworks.title: Camel and Arabs
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a camel in a desert landscape. The camel is adorned with items such as cloths and a rifle. In the background, there are buildings and seated figures dressed in traditional clothing. Simple architectural structures and a few palm trees can be seen. The drawing is intricately detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Tiger Sleeping in the Desert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a panther. The panther is laying on grass with its head lowered. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to show texture. There is a simple background with line work to suggest a distant landscape.

artworks.title: Arabes d'Oran
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in reclined positions. The man on the left is lying on his side with one arm propped under his head. He has a focused expression, a beard, and is wearing a headscarf, tunic, and cloak. The man next to him sits with his arms on his knees, his head slightly tilted. He displays a contemplative expression and wears a headscarf and cloak. In front of them is a long stick or rifle, a sack, and a small water vessel. The background shows sparse vegetation and distant figures on horseback and a person walking. The image is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Repos des Arabes (Arabs Resting)
artworks.description: The image shows three men seated in a cave-like setting from their knees upwards. The men appear relaxed and engaged in conversation. They have beards, mustaches, robes, and turbans. One man holds a long object, and the others have their hands resting on their knees. The surroundings are rocky, suggesting a secluded atmosphere. The scene is softly lit, accentuating the textures of the clothing and rocky background.
